description:
Join our Team!

We’re 3 Bachelor students from TH Nürnberg (2 Computer Science, 1 Electrical Engineering) with skills in AI/ML, data analysis, software engineering and more!

We have 3 spots left! We’d love to add frontend/web/UI/UX skills, GIS/mapping knowledge, creativity, presentation skills or an interest in space. But everyone with motivation is welcome!

Our project idea will take shape once the detailed challenge descriptions drop on Oct 28.

Curious? We’d love to have you on board!
